catalystSpot.preRunup: AVGO typically runs +5–12% in the 1–2 weeks before earnings, especially when AI chip design win news leaks (Apple, Google, Meta). Enter before earnings to capture the run-up rather than waiting for announcement day.

earningsHistory.note: 3 AI customers revealed, $60–90B TAM by 2027 — crossed $1T (outlier)
Beat + strong Q2 guide (~+16% after-hours, ~+8% next session)
Beat but FY27 AI target left unchanged → sell-the-news
Beat, AI chip sales to double — mostly priced in
Beat + raise, modest reaction at elevated valuation
Beat but FY27 AI target again unchanged → re-rate at premium

postWin.note: 7-quarter sample (FY24–FY26): 5 positive reactions averaging ~+10%. Median is closer to +5–8% — the +24% (Dec 2024 TAM reveal) is the outlier, not the base case. Big moves now require a genuinely new datapoint (new customer / TAM raise), not just a beat.

postLose.note: Recent regime (FY25–FY26): a beat is no longer enough. Jun 2025 −5% and Jun 2026 −13% both came on solid beats where the FY27 AI target was left unchanged. Note: May 2022 −26% was a pre-AI, lower-cap era and is no longer representative.

spotSizing.reason: Derived from a 10% high-conviction base, trimmed for mega-cap upside magnitude. At $1.95T a beat moves the stock far less than a mid-cap, so the spot is sized for a smaller, lower-variance payoff.
